title: request_architecture_review input
description: Asks for an ad hoc architecture review of an application or a change. The engine creates a Review (O21) of type architecture, status due, and it appears in the architect's queue. A request, never a decision: the review ends in a design decision that people answer on the decision page. If an open architecture review already exists for the subject, the tool returns it and writes nothing new.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9). An AI client may send the request where the Tool Policy row says AI May Submit = yes for subject kind review-request. Shipped yes.

changeRequestId.description: The change to review, if the review is about one change.

reason.description: What the reviewer should look at, and why.

dueOn.description: When the review is wanted. Leave out for today.

evidence.description: Links to the design material. Each becomes an Evidence Link (O20).

examples.reason: We plan to call an external mapping service.
